supersession.reason: Three changes, all before any generation. (1) The authoritative-guideline recommendation subset was expanded from the v4 baseline of 33 records to 66 by ingesting the remaining 8 cross-issuer PDFs (NICE x4, AAD x3, BAD x1), byte-exact verbatim; coverage rises 14->16 of 29 cells (BCC 6/6, melanoma 5/6, AK 5/5). (2) PERCEPTION IS RE-REGISTERED as a competed axis: v4 froze one shared diagnostic commitment for every arm (diagnosis tied), which foreclosed a diagnostic-accuracy claim. v5 unfreezes B0 only -- the M-family (M, B1, B4, B5, B6, A0-A4) still commits the frozen DermLIP probe (so the evidence-architecture comparison stays matched on perception), while B0 'VLM-only' diagnoses via the VLM. The probe is NOT retrained: it already scores ~0.84 accuracy on the natural-distribution held-out node-validation split (>= CALIBER's 0.798); the 0.762 figure was a class-balanced-subset artifact. Diagnosis therefore becomes a superiority claim (M over the VLM baseline) alongside the evidence/selective/provenance wins. (3) The generation-executing runner, all scorers, and the A2/D4/D3 defect resolutions landed and are registered here. PREREGISTRATION.json is bumped to schema 5 in lockstep.

paper_claims_under_test.claim: A typed multimodal EvidenceContract makes image support, evidence support, citations, contradiction state, uncertainty, and termination machine-checkable.
paper_claims_under_test.novelty_boundary: The operational contract and its measured completion are the contribution; structured output in general is not. Narrowed in v2: typed intermediate objects are prior art (MedAgent-Pro stores a JSON plan with per-step {Continue,Terminate,Complete} state; MedCoRAG emits stance/confidence/sufficiency; Retina-RAG serializes an image-bound P={g,e,s_g,s_e}). The defensible claim is the provenance composition -- source id, authority class, version, citation and content hash bound together -- plus the separation of an image-bound diagnosis from source-bound text.

paper_claims_under_test.claim: Patient-image exemplars plus authoritative text retrieval with cross-modal lineage improve evidence usefulness and traceability over single-pass dense RAG.
paper_claims_under_test.novelty_boundary: Knowledge graphs and provenance alone are not novel and provenance is never treated as truth. This is the strongest surviving gap: MedGraphRAG's triple-linking runs over MIMIC-IV EHR text with no image in the pipeline.

paper_claims_under_test.claim: A transparent bounded hierarchy recovers from typed evidence failures through at most one EXPAND, REFORMULATE, or INDEPENDENT_SOURCE action before PASS or ABSTAIN.
paper_claims_under_test.novelty_boundary: No learned depth-two policy and no HANDOFF are part of this claim. Narrowed in v2: neither boundedness nor failure-typing is novel. #104, #120 and #115 all cap their loops at three iterations; MED-VRAG ships a four-class error taxonomy as a contribution, DeepRare reports five failure modes, and #104 publishes a Failure-type-to-action table. Those taxonomies are post-hoc human annotation. The surviving claim is runtime typing that selects the next action, evaluated on action appropriateness and recovery by failure type.

paper_claims_under_test.claim: Structured verification and immutable receipts expose separate trajectory-trust dimensions instead of one composite trust score.
paper_claims_under_test.novelty_boundary: CATIA/GRiP and NIST AI RMF organize interpretation and governance; the frameworks themselves are not novelty. Narrowed in v2: 'trust is scored at the answer, not the trajectory' is false as stated. DeepRare scores per-reference accuracy, MedGraphRAG publishes citation precision/recall, and #104's confidence already penalizes loop depth. The surviving claim is the assembled protocol: selective risk/coverage plus action cost plus recovery-by-type on matched cases.

paper_claims_under_test.claim: A matched multi-paradigm evaluation jointly reports diagnosis, evidence quality, selective risk, recovery, coverage, and cost.
paper_claims_under_test.novelty_boundary: Published cross-dataset scores are reference bars, not H2H wins. Narrowed in v2: controlled cross-paradigm comparison is NOT missing from the literature. MR-RAG (CVPR) holds the Med-LVLM backbone fixed and varies only retrieval strategy; MedGraphRAG compares all retrieval methods under the same RAG data; #104 attributes differences to architecture. The surviving claim is the dermatology setting and the specific five-paradigm span. Note MedDr (#76) is a dermatology RAG reporting HAM10000 accuracy 0.707 and GSCo (#107) performs Retrieval-Augmented Diagnosis covering dermatology; 'no dermatology multimodal medical RAG exists' must not be claimed.

generation_runtime_v5.citation_policy: citation_integrity (primary provenance) is scored over the HOST-BUILT contract's guideline claims via citation_extraction.guideline_citations_from_contract. It is 1.0 by construction for covered M-family lesions and None for baselines -- the exclusive source-exact provenance GUARANTEE, not a generator-faithfulness test (that is RAGAS, supporting). This is coherent because guideline citations are inherently host-owned: the source-statement-integrity registry that makes them SUPPORTED can only be invoked by the host, not the VLM. The scorer is non-trivial (it detects hallucinated / unoffered / claim-type-mismatched ids in its tests) and verifies a falsifiable property; a correct architecture passes it. registration_defect_2026_08_08.defect: The registered evidence-superiority condition names four endpoints -- faithfulness, context recall, citation precision, contract completion -- and requires at least two to show a paired improvement whose 95% clustered-bootstrap interval excludes zero. But citation integrity (which replaced citation precision) and contract completion are UNDEFINED for a no-contract comparator, and the protocol correctly forbids imputing them as zero. Only two of the four are therefore ever testable, so the condition demands that BOTH survive Holm correction. That was not the intent and was not noticed until the paired CIs were actually computed.
registration_defect_2026_08_08.observed_consequence: On development the condition is met against B5 (faithfulness AND context recall both clear zero) but not against B1, B4 or B6, where context recall clears zero decisively and faithfulness is inconclusive.
registration_defect_2026_08_08.resolution_required_before_sealed: Issue spec v6 that (a) states plainly that citation_integrity and contract_completion are architectural, reported as not_applicable for no-contract arms and excluded from the inferential family; and (b) replaces them in the family with endpoints that ARE defined for every arm. Two candidates, both of which must be registered BEFORE the sealed run or not used: verifiable-citation coverage (does an answer carry at least one resolvable citation -- defined for every arm, 92/160 for M and 0/160 for every baseline), and scope-matched faithfulness (faithfulness restricted to answers where the text judge has jurisdiction; +0.3395 [0.2428, 0.4382] for M vs B1 on development, which is POST-HOC there and usable only if pre-registered here).
registration_defect_2026_08_08.hard_rule: No endpoint may be added to the frozen family retroactively for the DEVELOPMENT result. The development verdict stands as measured: met vs B5, not met vs B1.
